about: The collecta of the formulary “Second Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who seest that we are bereft of all strength, guard us within and without, that we may be defended in body from all adversities and cleansed in mind from evil thoughts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
